title: Microsoft Teams: Workflows template adds tag members to channels automatically
summary: The optional default, rollout dates and documented governance controls are supported. The changed cloud-flow sharing documentation still supports the ownership guidance. The licensing classification should acknowledge the published Microsoft 365 standard-connector entitlement while retaining the uncertainty about this template's connectors.

claims.claim: Microsoft is introducing a Teams Workflows template to add tag members to channels.
claims.quote: We are introducing the Join member to channel when user is added to tag template in the Workflows app to automatically add users to selected channels when they are added to a team tag.

claims.claim: The template is called Join member to channel when user is added to tag.
claims.quote: The Join member to channel when user is added to tag template will be available in the Workflows app.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Once configured, the workflow automatically adds newly added tag members to selected channels without individual manual channel additions.
claims.quote: Once configured, the workflow runs whenever a user is added to the tag, eliminating the need to add members to each channel manually.

claims.claim: Team owners can choose to configure the workflow.
claims.quote: Team owners can configure the workflow at any time if desired.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes location-based and project-based groups mapped to sites, regions or projects as useful cases.
claims.quote: This is especially useful for location-based or project-based groups where tags correspond to specific sites, regions, or projects, helping new members access relevant channels promptly.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The notice places the template within standard channels and shared channels shared with everyone on the team.
claims.quote: This applies to channels that all team members can access by default: standard channels and shared channels that are shared with everyone on the team.

claims.claim: The default is user-opt-in: nothing changes until someone in a team configures the optional template.

claims.quote: If your organization plans to use this template, we recommend reviewing your Power Automate and Workflows policies to confirm that it is permitted.

claims.claim: Any owner of a cloud flow can edit its definition.
claims.quote:
Any owner of a cloud flow can perform these actions:

- View the run history.
- Manage the properties of the flow (for example, start or stop the flow, add owners, or update credentials for a connection).
- Edit the definition of the flow (for example, add or remove an action or condition).

claims.claim: Any cloud-flow owner can stop the flow.
claims.quote: Manage the properties of the flow (for example, start or stop the flow, add owners, or update credentials for a connection).

claims.claim: When an owner whose credentials a connection uses is removed, those connection credentials need updating for the flow to continue running properly.
claims.quote: When you remove an owner whose credentials are used to access Power Automate services, update the credentials for those connections so that the flow continues to run properly.

claims.claim: Team owners and permitted team members can create and assign tags.
